company.shortDescription: Hydrovest Technology is a agritech company specializing in vertical farming, hydroponics, and sustainable agriculture solutions.
company.description: Hydrovest Technology Trading and Contracting W.L.L. is a Doha-based agritech firm specializing in climate-smart farming, vertical hydroponics, and sustainable food products.The company develops AI-driven vertical farming systems that optimize space, slash water use, and boost yields for crops like lettuce and melons. It emphasizes automated solutions aligned with Qatar National Vision 2030 for food security.
